## Resolution Summary
Both high-level review concerns and the inline comment were addressed. (1) The REQ-007/REQ-008 numbering gap is now explicitly explained in tests/e2e/keystone/invalid-cr/chainsaw-test.yaml with a fenced `Numbering gap (CC-0094 review-1)` block between REQ-006 and REQ-008, calling out that REQ-007 / 08-replicas-zero.yaml is intentionally absent because the mutating webhook coerces replicas:0 → 3 before the Minimum=1 marker fires, and that REQ-008 (replicas:-1) subsumes it. The numbering itself is left as-is so the REQ→manifest mapping in the CRD doc stays stable. (2) The YAML-duplication concern was addressed by adding tests/e2e/keystone/invalid-cr/_generate.py, a single-source-of-truth Python generator that emits all 10 CC-0094 fixtures from a canonical scaffold and supports a `--check` drift mode for CI; the existing 02-…/03-…/04-…/05-…/06-…/07-…/09-…/10-…/11-…/12-…yaml files are now treated as generated outputs. (3) The inline 'chainsaw' → 'Chainsaw' typo at docs/reference/keystone-c
